content.short: Crypto-to-real-world bill pay and card/off-ramp product.
content.description: Spritz is a crypto payments super app that lets people use stablecoins and crypto for real-world expenses without first cashing out to a bank. From their own wallet, US users can pay bills, mortgages, loans, and other routine expenses directly with tokens, or off-ramp crypto to fiat, turning digital assets into everyday spending power. Spritz supports paying with assets held across many networks, including Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Solana, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base, and connects those balances to bills and cards. By bridging DeFi wallets and traditional bills and merchants, Spritz creates practical real-world use cases for crypto, targeting people who hold stablecoins or crypto and want to live off it without constant manual conversions.
content.meta: Spritz lets you pay real-world bills and spend directly from crypto and stablecoins. Discover Spritz and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
